name: salon
description: Core packages for a self-hosted coding-agent workspace.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @salon/workspace run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run test
scripts.check:core: node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs && node scripts/check-case-collisions.mjs && node scripts/check-core-boundary.mjs && node scripts/privacy-scan.mjs
